name: graph-first-gate
description: Enforce the rules document instead of trusting the model to follow it: source files may not be read before the code graph has been consulted. v2 (2026-10-16) closes three holes found on a real Windows 11 machine: (1) one successful query used to unlock an hour of free reading — the session window is now 10 minutes; (2) bash reads (cat/grep/sed -n, and read calls inside python/node one-liners) were completely ungated — they now go through the same Layer-1 rule; (3) a scoped unlock records *what* a query was about (named files / packages / directories) so a targeted query keeps its target readable for 30 minutes without buying a repository-wide pass. The block cap was raised from 3 to 30 because giving up after three blocks made the gate cosmetic.
reminder:
[system-reminder · 三层代码阅读铁律 · 每轮生效]
read 代码文件前必须按序走 fallback，禁止跳层：
  Layer 1 图谱查询：先用 codebase-memory MCP（search_graph / trace_path / get_code_snippet / query_graph / get_architecture / search_code）查代码结构与调用关系；
  Layer 2 索引保障：项目未索引、或索引/embedding 过期（代码比索引新）时，先 index_repository 建索引 / detect_changes 检查更新，完成后回到 Layer 1 查图谱——不允许索引完直接 read；
  Layer 3 直读兜底：仅当图谱确实无法满足（非代码文件、图谱查不到、本会话自己改动的文件）才直接 read。
闸门强度：一次成功的图谱查询给 10 分钟会话窗口；查询里具体提到的文件/包/目录另给 30 分钟作用域解锁（例如查过 client.js，读它不需再查，读别的文件要另查）。
用 bash 读源码（cat / head / grep / sed -n / python -c "open(...)" 等）与用 read 工具同罪，同样被拦截；git status / ls 等不看内容的命令不受影响。
跳过 Layer 1/2 直接 read 项目代码 = 违规，会被工具闸门拦截。
